title: Zapier SDK: npm install + one login gives a coding agent authenticated access to 9,000 apps; loop in code and call the model only for judgement calls (HubSpot quiet-deals -> Slack script)

tools.name: Zapier SDK (@zapier/zapier-sdk)
tools.detail: npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk ; npx zapier-sdk login ; docs page 'Zapier SDK quickstart: TypeScript setup for Node.js 20+' with 'Open in Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / VS Code Copilot / ChatGPT / Claude / Perplexity' buttons

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: the coding agent that writes and runs the script

tools.name: HubSpot
tools.detail: source of deals; script pulls deals quiet for 14+ days

claims: Previously each deal was a full model round trip (read, think, write email) x200 and every round trip was billed
With the SDK the loop runs in code; the model is only called for the judgement part (what the message should say)
'Your agent has authenticated access to 9,000 apps' after one login command; never opened an API doc
SDK is free while in open beta
Terminal output: 'Scanned 3 deals in code - 3 quiet for 14+ days ... Model calls: 1 (one per quiet deal, zero for the loop). Tokens: 2%'
how_to_steps: npx zapier-sdk login (OAuth; authenticates all connected Zapier apps)
Ask Claude Code to write one script (src/quiet-deals.ts) that pulls HubSpot deals with no activity for 14 days
Loop over deals in code; call the LLM only to draft the follow-up message per deal
Post the summary (with HubSpot record links) to Slack; run with npx tsx
on_screen_only: Zapier docs nav: Integrations, Powered by Zapier, White Label, MCP, SDK, Connectors; 'Install @zapier/zapier-sdk via npm, authenticate with OAuth or client credentials, and execute actions across 9,000+ apps'
Mock dashboard 'Pipeline Ops - Deal queue' with Read / Think / Write x200 'round trips'
npm warning: 'install scripts blocked ... postinstall: node install.js ... run `npm install-scripts ls` to review'
Script output listing Acme Corp / Globex / Initech quiet 32/30/30 days with app-na2.hubspot.com record URLs and suggested next action

relevance.why: Directly applicable: Haji already has a Zapier MCP wired up; the SDK pattern (deterministic loop in code, model only for judgement) cuts token spend on any recurring business automation.

implement_score.why: Two commands to set up; the architectural lesson is free and reusable (scripts for loops, LLM for decisions). Try on one recurring task such as lead follow-ups or weekly stats.

verify: Is @zapier/zapier-sdk GA or still beta, and what will it cost per task once billed?

gap.what: Zapier SDK as an agent-authenticated code library and the explicit cost principle 'looping is free, you only pay for thinking'; liked set covered Apify connector and MCPs but not code-level Zapier access.
